'''March 2001 Las Vegas tournament (before 8 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Las Vegas in March 2001. It is known from Danny Rider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1853">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-08-vegas-in-my-pantsd1853/ vegas-in-my-pants], DeckTech (Danny "Skuff D" Rider, 8 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-08-vegas-in-my-pantsd1853/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' March 2001
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
